pyq_bad.why: garbled: Rig Vedic religion statements mixed with Ashokan edict text; options interleaved
suspect key: Yava = barley, not millet (keyed only because barley is absent from List-II)

patterns: Single-term recall dominates: Aghanya = cow, most valuable property = cow, Yava = barley, Panis = traders, Nishka = neck ornament later a coin.
Women seers odd-one-out: Gargi (and Maitreyi) are not Rigvedic; Lopamudra/Ghosha/Apala/Vishvavara are.

Religion items: Indra = war god, most hymns, largest hymn; Agni second; Rita = natural/cosmic law; Boghazkoi names Indra-Varuna-Mitra-Nasatyas (APPSC G2); statement sets on Dyaus = Zeus and Prithvi vs Aditi (APPSC G1).
App MCQs closely mirror PYQ facts and add deeper term-matching (Gomat, Gavyuti, Datra, Titau) and later-Vedic taxation; depth is somewhat above PYQs but sound.
